newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Unions say no strike yet for Venezuela CANTV.
newsitem.headline: Unions say no strike yet for Venezuela CANTV.

text.p: Unions at Venezuelan telephone company CANTV said a strike threatened for this week would not take place, although the possibility of future action could not be ruled out.

"We're not ruling out strikes ... but we do want to use all ways possible before we take any action," said Cruz Hernandez, president of the Federation of Venezuelan Telecommunication workers which groups the 29 unions working for CANTV.
CANTV labor and management are in the midst of negotiations over wage contracts for 1997 and 1998.

Workers have asked for a 120 percent wage rise to compensate for 103 percent inflation in 1996. CANTV has so far offered increases, including bonuses, of 34 percent for this year and 65 percent for the next. The offer is to due to be discussed by labor February 5.
